hero.tagline: National Govt Hospital Outpatient AI Prototype • SevaPass
hero.demoDataBadge: DEMO DATA: No real Aadhaar or telephony required
hero.subtitle: Book outpatient appointments at government hospitals by speaking naturally in your own language. No long registration lines, no typing UHID numbers. Get an instant digital QR pass on your phone and walk directly to your doctor's consultation room.
hero.motto: "Less Queue. Less Confusion. More Accessible Healthcare."
hero.simSpeechBubble: "Namaste Meera Ji. Booking confirmed for your son Aarav with Dr. Sharma (Ophthalmology) at 10:00 AM. Your pass is ready!"

voice.portalSubtitle: Speak naturally or click conversation options to book appointments with Dr. Sharma (Ophthalmology) or other specialists.
voice.noUhidBannerText: Register or schedule directly through the official Kerala Government e-Health portal.
voice.quickOptionsTip: Click quick options or speak into microphone:
voice.drawerSubtitle: As the citizen speaks naturally, the Voice Agent dispatches server-side JSON tool calls. Sensitive Aadhaar or raw UHID numbers are never exposed over voice.
voice.drawerWaiting: Awaiting voice trigger to execute API tools...
voice.securityTag: Security Model: Phone is identifier, OTP is authentication, QR token is random key without medical records.

pass.showcaseSubtitle: Generated dynamically through voice call. Scannable at hospital entry and consultation rooms.
pass.cardOfficialHeader: Government of Kerala • Directorate of Health Services
pass.tokenInstruction: Show this QR token at the hospital main entrance and consultation room.

dashboard.noActivePassesDesc: Use our AI voice helpline to book for yourself or your children in seconds.
dashboard.dependentsDesc: Family members linked to your verified phone. When booking by voice, you only speak their name — their hospital record is resolved silently in the background.
dashboard.childTag: Child records are gated by guardian mobile authentication. No public listing of children's medical history.
dashboard.noUhidBannerDesc: Don't have a UHID? You can easily register and book an outpatient consultation ticket using the Kerala Government e-Health portal.

checkin.headerSubtitle: Hospital staff scan the citizen's SevaPass QR code or enter appointment ID to confirm arrival at OPD.
checkin.scannerInstruction: Point camera at digital pass QR or select recent pass below to check-in.

navigation.headerSubtitle: Step-by-step route to reach your consultation room without asking around or waiting in central queues.
navigation.step1Desc: Scan your QR pass at Security Gate 1 for contact-free entry.
navigation.step2Desc: Take Lift B or central staircase to Floor 2.
navigation.step3Desc: Turn right past the Nurse Station towards Room 204.
navigation.step4Desc: Arrived at Room 204. Your token number is queued on the digital display.

admin.headerSubtitle: Real-time visibility into OPD queues, active consults, room allocations, and doctor availability across departments.

sos.telemetrySubtitle: Emergency SOS voice calls automatically dispatch server-side alerts to ambulance units and hospital casualty triage without manual paperwork.

workflow.title: How VEGAM Works
workflow.subtitle: 10-Step Automated Hospital Journey — From Phone Call to Consultation Room
workflow.headline: CALL → VERIFY → SPEAK → BOOK → PASS → CHECK-IN
workflow.tagline: "Less Queue. Less Confusion. More Accessible Healthcare."

features.zeroTypingDesc: Designed for citizens without smartphones, elderly individuals, and visually impaired users. All hospital UHID lookups occur server-side.
features.privacyTokenDesc: Pass QR codes contain only cryptographic random session tokens — never Aadhaar numbers, full UHID, or sensitive clinical diagnoses.
features.roomNavDesc: Bypass chaotic central OPD queues. Walk straight to your assigned wing (e.g. Room 204, Floor 2) with step-by-step wayfinding instructions.
